title: MiniMax 旗下 Talkie 因涉黄被苹果 App Store 下架
content: MiniMax’s AI companion app, Talkie, was removed from the Apple App Store due to the presence of pornography. This incident exposes significant compliance risks inherent in AI role-playing applications, where user prompts and model hallucinations render traditional content moderation insufficient. content: Sam's Club successfully expanded to 70 stores in China, while domestic competitors like Hema and RT-Mart exited or scaled back due to capital impatience. Local firms failed because their investors sought quick returns, they lacked operational autonomy within their parent groups, and they could not sustain the heavy pre-profit investments. title: A社曝光了一份AI整顿职场魔幻实录，请甩给你那位沉迷AI提效的老板
content: Anthropic’s report reveals a new workplace contradiction: AI-generated efficiencies often increase employee workloads and complicate management, as companies struggle to decide who benefits from time saved. While 55% of AI applications boost corporate productivity and 19% reduce costs, only 7% directly benefit employees. Consequently, many workers conceal their use of AI to protect their jobs or secure personal leisure. Facing declining recruitment needs and reduced outsourcing, companies must adapt workflows and retrain staff. Successful adoption requires aligning AI gains with employee benefits to prevent a future shortage of experienced professionals.

title: “出生在罗马与走向罗马”：普林斯顿女博士谢翌的十年突围与坠落 | 原文
content: Eva Yi Xie, a 24-year-old third-year neuroscience PhD student at Princeton, was detained by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement officers at Reagan National Airport. This occurred immediately after she presented a poster at the Society for Neuroscience annual meeting. Xie messaged her lab via Slack for help before losing contact. She was subsequently held in federal custody and re-established contact with the outside world the following morning. The incident highlighted the risks faced by international students due to immigration enforcement at major venues.
